candidate_readme:
# Agent Trace

Exports the pi agent loop as a local OpenTelemetry trace so eval harnesses can see what a run actually did, with timings and token accounting.

Load it with `pi -e packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/agent-trace` or by pointing `DefaultResourceLoader` at this directory.

## Trace file

Spans are appended as JSON Lines to:

```
<SessionManager.getSessionDir()>/traces/<session-id>.otlp.jsonl
```

Set `PI_AGENT_TRACE_FILE` to replace that path. The directory is created on demand. Each line is one OTLP/JSON `ExportTraceServiceRequest` holding a single span. A span is written twice: a **start** line (attribute `pi.span.phase` = `"start"`, no `endTimeUnixNano` or `status`) at the event that opens it, and an **end** line with the same ids, `endTimeUnixNano`, and `status` once the span has finished. A reader that de-duplicates by `spanId` (last line wins) always holds the current state; a start without an end is in progress. Reloads and later processes append to the same file.

## Spans

| name | kind | parent | start / end |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pi.run` | INTERNAL (1) | none, or `PI_AGENT_TRACE_PARENT` | `agent_start` / `agent_end` |
| `pi.turn` | INTERNAL (1) | the run | `turn_start` / `turn_end` |
| `chat <model>` | CLIENT (3) | the turn | assistant `message_start` / first `tool_execution_start` or `turn_end` |
| `execute_tool <name>` | INTERNAL (1) | the turn | `tool_execution_start` / `turn_end` |
| `pi.compaction` | INTERNAL (1) | none, or `PI_AGENT_TRACE_PARENT` | `session_before_compact` / `session_compact` or `session_compact_failed` |

Run triggers: `prompt` (a `before_agent_start` preceded the start), `continuation` (start arrived before the previous run's `agent_settled`), or `wakeup` (idle `sendMessage` with `triggerTurn`). Steering messages stay in the same run (`pi.run.steer_count` / `pi.run.steer_entry_ids`). Overflow recovery is a `continuation` with `pi.run.after_compaction` and no `pi.session.entry_id`.

## Sub-agents

While a tool runs, `PI_AGENT_TRACE_PARENT` is set to `<traceId>-<spanId>` of that tool span (the most recently started still-running tool if several overlap). Child pi processes inherit it, use that `traceId`, and parent their root spans (runs, compactions) on that `spanId`. Each process still writes its own session trace file.

## Failures

- Tool `isError`, assistant `stopReason` `error`/`aborted`, and failed compaction are ERROR (`status.code` 2). Runs stay OK even when a turn fails.
- `session_shutdown` ends every open span with ERROR `"shutdown"`, child-first.
- A write failure is reported once per process via `sendMessage` (`customType: "agent-trace"`, `triggerTurn: false`) whose text starts with `agent-trace: cannot write`. Later spans are still attempted if the path recovers.
